environment.execution: Relocated R runtime on host Linux kernel/glibc; no Docker

resume.adjustment: Require overlapping real child tasks in the four principal workflow cases; the two additional tiny CPI cases still require distinct actual child PIDs and report observed overlap.
resume.original_status: failed only at the overlap gate for the repeated tiny CPI interval case

cases.behavior: paused real samtools reaped; partial output removed

limitations: No Docker image, Windows/WSL, macOS/Lima or installer qualification.
Synthetic fixture equivalence does not establish equivalence for every possible real input.
Manual maximum four is a cap, not a demand for four workers; observed plans respect actual CPU and memory.
Worker counts cover computation processes; an additional R coordinator and non-R processes may exist.
Memory scheduling is heuristic and does not guarantee a hard RAM bound.
No whole-workflow speedup or peak-RAM claim is made; instrumented single execution times are not a benchmark.
PDF equality compares page pixels at 36 DPI and excludes metadata.

reproduction.command_scope: Run from this code commit after building its runtime image; this command performs a separate Docker qualification, not the rootless execution reported here.
reproduction.rootless_adapter: Uses the same verifier/capture/comparison sources with /repo and /opt/nipat mapped to the checkout, /inputs to synthetic fixtures, /results to per-execution directories, Rscript to R 4.4.2, and samtools to the extracted runtime. Source hashes are checked before and after.

scope: Local scientific source qualification on synthetic fixtures

synthetic_performance.memory: Rprofmem allocation totals from a separate pass; not peak RAM
synthetic_performance.scope: source transformations and CPI core; three timing observations per variant
